# Abilian Innovation Lab

> > Research and development hub exploring next-generation platforms (Hyper Open X, Hop3, Nua), concurrent Python (Cython+), and sovereign cloud technologies.

The Abilian Innovation Lab documents R&D projects in WebAssembly compilation, edge computing, digital sovereignty, and cloud orchestration, alongside business practices and knowledge management frameworks. It bridges cutting-edge technical work with strategic business methodologies.

## Key Topics

- Cython+
- Hyper Open X (HOX)
- Hop3
- Nua
- Python to WASM Compiler
- WebAssembly (WASM)
- Digital Sovereignty
- Cloud Orchestration
- Edge Computing
- Concurrent Programming
- Open Source Economics
- OKR (Objectives and Key Results)
- Knowledge Management
- Business Model Canvas
- W. Edwards Deming

## Core R&D Projects

- [Abilian Innovation Lab](https://lab.abilian.com): Homepage showcasing R&D projects: Hyper Open X, Hop3, Nua platforms
- [Cython+ (2020-2022)](https://lab.abilian.com/Projects/Cython+/Cython+%20(2020-2022)): Cython+ project: concurrent Python without GIL (2020-2022)
- [EU OS](https://lab.abilian.com/Projects/EU%20OS/00%20EU%20OS): EU OS: sovereign Linux distribution with bootc and fleet management

## Web Server & Performance

- [State of the Art - Web server](https://lab.abilian.com/Projects/Cython%2B/Web%20server/State%20of%20the%20Art%20-%20Web%20server): Survey of web server tech: HTTP/2, HTTP/3, WSGI, ASGI, Python servers
- [Mongrel2](https://lab.abilian.com/Projects/Cython%2B/Web%20server/Mongrel2): Mongrel2 web server by Zed Shaw: language-agnostic with ZeroMQ

## Business Practices & Strategy

- [OKR Workshop](https://lab.abilian.com/Business/Practices/OKR%20Workshop): Workshop guide for implementing Objectives and Key Results (OKR)
- [The Heilmeier Catechism](https://lab.abilian.com/Business/R%26D%20and%20Innovation/The%20Heilmeier%20Catechism): DARPA's Heilmeier Catechism framework for R&D project evaluation
- [Business Model Canvas](https://lab.abilian.com/Business/Business%20Models/Business%20Model%20Canvas): Guide to Business Model Canvas by Osterwalder & Pigneur
- [Marketing Trends for 2025](https://lab.abilian.com/Business/Marketing/Marketing%20Trends%20for%202025): 2025 marketing predictions: authenticity, personalization, automation
- [Planning](https://lab.abilian.com/Business/Practices/Planning): Business planning practices and goal-setting methodologies
- [Incentives](https://lab.abilian.com/Business/Practices/Incentives): Analysis of incentives and unintended consequences (Wells Fargo, Enron)

## Knowledge Management

- [KM at SMEs](https://lab.abilian.com/Business/Knowledge%20Management/KM%20at%20SMEs): Knowledge management practices for small and medium enterprises
- [The Forster Method - DIT](https://lab.abilian.com/Business/Personal%20Knowledge%20Management/The%20Forster%20Method%20-%20DIT): Mark Forster's Do It Tomorrow (DIT) time management methodology
- [Mind Mapping](https://lab.abilian.com/Business/Personal%20Knowledge%20Management/Mind%20Mapping): Mind mapping tools: PlantUML, FreeMind, jsmind, MindNode

## Marketing & Customer Relations

- [Rethinking Lead Qualification - A Strategic Approach to CRM](https://lab.abilian.com/Business/Customer%20Relationship%20Management/Rethinking%20Lead%20Qualification%20-%20A%20Strategic%20Approach%20to%20CRM): Strategic guide to CRM lead qualification and management practices
- [UGC](https://lab.abilian.com/Business/Marketing/UGC): User-Generated Content strategy framework for marketing and growth

## Business Reference & Theory

- [00 Authors](https://lab.abilian.com/Business/Authors%20%26%20Leaders/00%20Authors): Index of business authors: Drucker, Deming, Moore, Grove
- [W. Edwards Deming](https://lab.abilian.com/Business/Authors%20%26%20Leaders/W.%20Edwards%20Deming): Profile on W. Edwards Deming and Total Quality Management (TQM)
- [Economic studies on OSS](https://lab.abilian.com/Business/Business%20Models/Economic%20studies%20on%20OSS): Economic research on open-source by Lerner, Tirole, and others
- [Public Benefit Companies](https://lab.abilian.com/Business/Legal/Public%20Benefit%20Companies): Overview of Public Benefit Companies (PBC) and B Corporation structures
